baseline_correction_from_user_attachment.decision: Use C6-B1-lite as primary safety anchor to avoid compounding B2 top-k tradeoff with video-slot drift; report and guard against C6-B2 separately.

paper_grounding.CONQUER: two-stage VCMR and contextual query-aware ranking retained as base.
paper_grounding.MA_VR: moment predictions condition video relevance via moment-aware evidence/gating.
paper_grounding.PREM_PRVR: partial relevance motivates bag-of-moments MIL pooling at video level.
paper_grounding.BSN_BMN: boundary/proposal confidence is used as feature evidence, not a new backbone.
paper_grounding.GenSpan: design note only; no generator or C6-D training in this stage.
